```{r}
#####################################################
############### Without interactions ################

rm(list = ls())        # remove all objects
gc()  # forces R to return unused memory back to the OS

source("BiodivAF.R")
source("BiodivAF-check.R")
library(patchwork)   # for arranging multiple ggplots
library(gridExtra)   # for empty placeholder text

# Define threshold for outlier models
rmse_threshold <- 5
# Filter groups
all_groups <- FALSE
groups_of_focus <- c("Overall", "Arthropods", "Soil-related invertebrates", "Aboveground invertebrates", "Flying vertebrates", "Ground-dwelling vertebrates", 
                  "Autotrophs", "Pollinators", "Natural enemies", "Soil fauna", "Pest species", 
                  "Microbiota", "Aves", "Chiroptera", "Araneae", "Coleoptera", "Hymenoptera", "Gastropoda", "Lepidoptera", "Isopoda", 
                  "Butterflies", "Moths", "Bees", "Lumbricidae", "Hoverflies")
metrics_of_focus <- c("SR","ab")

# --- Preallocate ---
mods_list <- list( # Single list, must be duplicated for SA/SP additions
  ## 9 moderators (fixed + all 4 optional)
  c("AF_plottype", "Age","Tree_SR","Shrub_layer","forestshrub_frac","Climate","Tree.pol","Alley.width", "landscape_shannon"),
  ## 8 moderators (3 optional)
  c("AF_plottype", "Age","Tree_SR","Shrub_layer","forestshrub_frac","Climate","Tree.pol","Alley.width"),
  c("AF_plottype", "Age","Tree_SR","Shrub_layer","forestshrub_frac","Climate","Tree.pol","landscape_shannon"),
  c("AF_plottype", "Age","Tree_SR","Shrub_layer","forestshrub_frac","Climate","landscape_shannon","Alley.width"),
  c("AF_plottype", "Age","Tree_SR","Shrub_layer","forestshrub_frac","landscape_shannon","Tree.pol","Alley.width"),
  ## 7 moderators (choose 2 optional)
  c("AF_plottype", "Age","Tree_SR","Shrub_layer","forestshrub_frac","Climate","Soil_type"),
  c("AF_plottype", "Age","Tree_SR","Shrub_layer","forestshrub_frac","Climate","Tree.pol"),
  c("AF_plottype", "Age","Tree_SR","Shrub_layer","forestshrub_frac","Climate","Alley.width"),
  c("AF_plottype", "Age","Tree_SR","Shrub_layer","forestshrub_frac","Soil_type","Tree.pol"),
  c("AF_plottype", "Age","Tree_SR","Shrub_layer","forestshrub_frac","Soil_type","Alley.width"),

interactions_list <- list(

interactions_list <- cbind(interactions_list, interactions_list)  # Duplicate for SA/SP additions

SA_SP.add_list <- c(rep(TRUE, 19), rep(FALSE, 19))
new_val_needed <- c(rep(TRUE, 1), rep(FALSE, 37))

```

One repition given below, alternate numbers for `rep_id` to alter output filenames.
```{r}
#######################
#### Repetition 1 #####
#######################

# Define number of repeats
n_repeats <- 1 

all_preds <- NULL
# ------------------------------------
# --- Run model in n_repeats times ---
# ------------------------------------
for (rep_id in 1:n_repeats) {
  rep_id <- 1

  # --------------------------------
  # --- Loop over moderator sets ---
  # --------------------------------
  all_preds <- lapply(1:length(SA_SP.add_list), function(p) {
    optie <<- "Dependent validation set"
    new.validation.needed <<- new_val_needed[p] # Make sure validation sets do not alter within testing of a model structure
    mods <<- mods_list[[p]]
    interactions <<- interactions_list[[p]]
    SA.add <<- SA_SP.add_list[p]
    SP.add <<- SA_SP.add_list[p]

    formula_str <- paste("~", paste(mods, collapse = "+"))

    # --- model building happens here ---
    source("Model_updates.R")

    # ----------------------------------
    # --- # of moderators and models ---
    # ----------------------------------
    model_files <- list.files("model_outputs", pattern = "^(model|modelpredlow)_.*\\.rds$", full.names = FALSE)
    n_models <- length(model_files) 

    # -----------------------
    # --- Run predictions ---
    # -----------------------
    preds <- tryCatch({
      purrr::map_dfr(model_files, ~ predict_from_saved_rma_model(.x, validation)) %>%
        mutate(model_nr = p,
               formula  = formula_str,
               SA.add   = SA.add,
               n_models = n_models,
               rep_id = rep_id)  # track repeat  
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Prediction failed for model ", p, " repeat ", rep_id, ": ", e$message)
      NULL
    })
  })
}
all_preds <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_preds)

write.csv(all_preds, "10-fold-predictions/_rep1.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
model_eval <- data.frame(
  model_nr = integer(),
  formula = character(),
  correct_in_CI = numeric(),
  mean_CI_width = numeric(),
  outlier_prev = numeric(),
  slope = numeric(),
  slope_p = numeric(),
  intercept_p = numeric(),
  rmse_1to1 = numeric(),
  pll = numeric(),
  ic = numeric(),
  n_models = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
best_coef <- 1000
plots_list <- list()

# ------------------------------------
# --- Combine all repeats - output ---
# ------------------------------------
library(readr)
# Define folder and file pattern
folder <- "10-fold-predictions/"
files <- paste0(folder, "_rep", 1:10, ".csv")  # adjust if filenames differ
# Read all CSVs and combine
all_preds_combined <- files %>%
  lapply(read_csv) %>%     # or read.csv() if you prefer base R
  bind_rows()  # combine into single data frame
all_preds <- all_preds_combined

# ----------------------------------
# --- Loop over model structures ---
# ----------------------------------
for (p in 1:length(SA_SP.add_list)){
  mods <- mods_list[[p]]
  interactions <- interactions_list[[p]]
  SA.add <- SA_SP.add_list[p]
  SP.add <- SA_SP.add_list[p]
  
  preds_structure <- all_preds %>% filter(model_nr == p)
  n_models <- preds_structure %>%
    distinct(rep_id, n_models) %>% 
    summarise(n_models = sum(n_models)) %>% pull(n_models)
  
  if (!"ROM_Pred" %in% names(preds_structure) || nrow(preds_structure) == 0) {
    formula_str <- paste("~", paste(mods, collapse = "+"))
    
    # --- Placeholder plot if failed ---
    p1 <- ggplot() + 
      annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, 
               label = paste("Model", p),
               size = 3, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5) +
      theme_void()
    
    # Also store NA in evaluation
    model_eval <- rbind(
      model_eval,
      data.frame(
        formula = paste("Model", p, ":", formula_str, " || SA/SP.add = ", SA.add),
        model_nr = p,
        correct_in_CI = NA,
        mean_CI_width = NA,
        outlier_prev = NA,
        slope = NA,
        slope_p = NA,
        intercept_p = NA,
        rmse_1to1 = NA,
        pll = NA,
        ic = NA,
        n_models = NA,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    
  } else {
    model_files <- list.files("model_outputs", pattern = "^model_.*\\.rds$", full.names = FALSE)
    formula_str <- paste("~", paste(mods, collapse = "+"))
    
    # --- Evaluate ---
    outliers <- preds_structure %>% mutate(is_outlier = abs(ROM_Pred) > 5)
    outlier_prevalence <- nrow(filter(outliers, is_outlier)) / nrow(preds_structure)
    
    results <- evaluate_model(preds_structure)
    
    model_eval <- rbind(
      model_eval,
      data.frame(
        model_nr = p,
        formula = paste("Model", p, ":", formula_str, " || SA/SP.add = ", SA.add),
        correct_in_CI = results$correct_in_CI,
        mean_CI_width = results$mean_CI_width,
        outlier_prev = outlier_prevalence,
        slope = results$slope,
        slope_p = results$slope_p,
        intercept_p = results$intercept_p,
        rmse_1to1 = results$rmse_1to1,
        pll = results$pll,
        ic = results$ic,
        n_models = n_models,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    
    # --- Plot ---
    p1 <- ggplot(preds_structure, aes(x = yi, y = ROM_Pred)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
                  color = "black", linewidth = 1.25) +
      geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_abline(intercept = results$intercept, slope = results$slope,
              color = "blue", linewidth = 1.5) +
      labs(
        x = "Raw data (ROM)",
        y = "Metafor Prediction (ROM)",
        title = paste("Model", p, ":", formula_str, "SA/SP.add = ", SA.add)) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "italic", hjust = 0.5)) +
      xlim(-5, 5) + ylim(-5, 5) 
    
    p_tmp <- ggplot(preds_structure, aes(x = yi, y = ROM_Pred)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
                  color = "black", linewidth = 1.25) +
      geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_abline(intercept = results$intercept, slope = results$slope,
              color = "blue", linewidth = 1.5) +
      labs(
        x = "Raw data (ROM)",
        y = "Metafor Prediction (ROM)",
        title = paste("Model", p, ":", formula_str, " || SA/SP.add = ", SA.add)) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "italic", hjust = 0.5))

    print(p1)
    
    if (!is.na(results$slope) && abs(1-results$slope) < best_coef){
      p_best_model <- p1
      p_best_model_outliers <- p_tmp
      best_coef <- abs(1-results$slope)
    }
    
    # --- Adjust plots for grid visualization ---
    p1 <-ggplot(preds_structure, aes(x = yi, y = ROM_Pred)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
                  color = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
      geom_point(size = 0.25, alpha = 0.4) +
      #geom_abline(intercept = results$intercept, slope = results$slope,
      #        color = "blue", linewidth = 0.5) +
      labs(title = paste("Model", p)) +
      xlim(-3, 3) + ylim(-3, 3) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.title = element_blank(), 
            axis.text = element_blank(), 
            axis.ticks = element_blank(), 
            plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2), # tighter margins 
            plot.title = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5)) + 
      coord_fixed(ratio = 1) # ensures square plots 
    
  }
  
  plots_list[[p]] <- p1
}

# Ensure no rownames creep in
rownames(model_eval) <- NULL 

# Inspect comparison table
model_eval <- model_eval %>%
  mutate(
    # Standardize metrics (z-scores)
    z_rmse              = scale(rmse_1to1),             # smaller = better !!! differences in datasets
    z_pll               = scale(-pll),                  # bigger = better !!! differences in datasets
    z_ic                = scale(ic),                    # smaller = better !!! differences in datasets
    z_outlier           = scale(outlier_prev),          # smaller = better !!! differences in datasets + shouldn't they be removed?
    z_slope             = scale(abs(1 - slope)),        # smaller = better
    z_slope_p           = scale(-slope_p),              # bigger = better
    z_intercept_p       = scale(-intercept_p),          # bigger = better # What relevance?
    z_correct           = scale(-correct_in_CI),        # bigger = better
    z_mean_CI_width     = scale(mean_CI_width),         # smaller = better # Combination of significance level and cI width needed
    z_n_models          = scale(-n_models),              # bigger = better

    # Total score = sum of standardized metrics
    total_score = z_rmse + z_n_models) %>%
  arrange(total_score) %>%
  dplyr::select(formula, model_nr, correct_in_CI, mean_CI_width, outlier_prev, slope, slope_p, intercept_p, rmse_1to1, pll, ic, n_models, total_score)

model_eval
write.csv(model_eval, "model_evaluation_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
p_best_model
p_best_model_outliers

plots_list <- plots_list[model_eval$model_nr]  # Reorder plots according to evaluation
# --- Arrange panels (5x5) ---
plots_per_page <- 25
num_pages <- ceiling(length(plots_list) / plots_per_page)

for (page in 1:num_pages) {
  start_idx <- (page - 1) * plots_per_page + 1
  end_idx <- min(page * plots_per_page, length(plots_list))
  
  grid <- wrap_plots(plots_list[start_idx:end_idx], ncol = 5, nrow = 5, byrow = TRUE) &
    theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1))  # remove global extra margins
  
  ggsave(filename = paste0("model_validation_page_", page, ".png"),
         plot = grid, width = 42, height = 42, units = "cm"  )
}
```
